description: Create a private ticket and signed Base USDC/ETH checkout for one published professional service. Accepts public HTTPS websites or public GitHub repositories only. Never include credentials, tokens, secrets, private repository URLs, or confidential data. The returned svc_ ticket is shown once and is the only delivery-retrieval credential.

authorizationConfirmed.description: Must be true: confirms the target is public and the requester is authorized to commission a passive, non-destructive review.

notes.description: Optional review focus. Never include credentials, tokens, secrets, private URLs, or confidential data.

publishTarget.description: Optional explicit consent to show the target and status in the public work queue. Defaults to false.

targetUrl.description: Public HTTPS website or exact public GitHub repository URL. Do not include credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
